verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is confirmed open-source (Apache 2.0) and runs as a local terminal tool, satisfying a narrow reading of self-hosting the client, but the evidence shows it is fundamentally tied to Google's cloud-hosted Gemini models via sign-in with a Google account or API key rather than a fully self-hostable backend/model stack. No documentation describes deploying the model or full stack independently of Google's services. Missing for 10: self-hosted model/inference option, self-hosted backend deployment docs, independent confirmation of running fully offline/self-managed.
